# Meridian 1.3.0
Seconds, at a glance, without crowding the main time.
- Add a compact **seconds orbit** to the right of each desktop clock’s date and weekday. - Read **00–59** in the center while 60 fine ticks light up clockwise through the minute. - Keep the main **HH:mm**, full **YYYY/MM/DD**, weather and desktop layout. - Update each desktop column once per second on whole-second system-clock boundaries, independently of menu bar layout and weather fetching. - Keep seconds synchronized across regions, including fractional offsets; update time and date together at minute and midnight boundaries. - Include seconds in the accessible clock description. Keep clock synchronization running while menus are open or the panel is dragged.
Your selected clocks, menu bar choices and panel position are preserved. **Open** brings the desktop panel forward; **×** sends it back to the menu bar without quitting.
Download **Meridian-1.3.0-macOS.dmg**, open it and drag Meridian.app onto Applications. The ZIP is used for signed Sparkle updates. Universal for Apple Silicon and Intel; macOS 14 or later.
This build uses ad-hoc Apple code signing and is **not Apple-notarized**. Sparkle update signatures are verified separately.
**Noncommercial use only**, under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Third-party components keep their own licenses; notices are included.
## 简体中文
每个日期右侧新增 **环形秒数**：中间显示 00–59，外圈 60 个刻度按秒顺时针推进。大号时分、完整年月日、天气和原有布局保留。
桌面时钟独立按系统时间每秒刷新，秒数跨地区同步，跨分钟、午夜时日期与时间一起更新；不会每秒重建状态栏面板或请求天气。辅助功能可读取含秒的时间。打开菜单或拖动面板时也会继续同步。
保留已有地区、状态栏选择和面板位置。点击 **打开** 唤起桌面面板，点击 **×** 收起到状态栏，程序继续运行。
请下载 **DMG 安装包**；ZIP 用于签名自动更新。此版尚未经过 Apple 公证，仅限非商业使用。
